_comment: Mermaid theme for the book's diagrams. The print edition is black and white,
so nothing here may carry meaning in hue alone: every distinction a reader
needs is available as fill lightness, border weight, or line style. The
greys are the same five steps used by the hand-drawn SVGs in src/, so a
Mermaid figure and an SVG figure on facing pages look like the same book.
htmlLabels is false everywhere, and that setting is load-bearing. By default
Mermaid puts node labels in a <foreignObject> holding HTML. Browsers render
that, so the mdbook edition looked correct -- but librsvg does not implement
foreignObject at all, so the rsvg-convert pass to PDF silently dropped every
label and the print edition came out as pages of empty boxes. With htmlLabels
off, Mermaid emits real SVG <text>, which both renderers understand.
